endorsements.quote: Thus, for successful societal integration of AI, it is essential not only to empirically demonstrate the efficacy and safety of AI systems but also to acknowledge the limits of relying solely on model interpretability.
AI ought to be integrated as a tool that enhances human expertise and decision-making, not as a replacement for human involvement.
Effective collaboration between AI developers and domain specialists is key to ensuring that AI systems align with the specific goals and requirements of scientific and medical applications.
Healthcare professionals must also be equipped with the knowledge and skills to leverage AI technologies responsibly and understand their limitations and potential risks.

unlisted_practices: Develop multimodal AI models that integrate visual, textual, audio, and video inputs.
Develop diverse, open-source AI models and promote open science practices.
Improve AI model performance in languages other than English.
Incorporate expertise from cognitive science, psychology, and human-computer interaction to balance AI performance with explainability.
Adopt an 'AI plus' approach to training and collaboration combining AI with a specific research domain.
Educate learners to cultivate human attributes such as critical thinking and curiosity to counter AI overuse undermining essential skills.
Include technical aspects, ethical guidelines, and legal liabilities of AI use in medical decision-making in healthcare professional AI education.
Promote a culture of ethical awareness and responsible AI use, and encourage development and adoption of ethical guidelines in AI education.
Conduct social science research to promote public acceptance and reduce biases against AI systems.
Aim to develop AI systems that significantly improve on accuracy, bias reduction, and equitable outcomes compared to existing alternatives.
